$comment: Canned replies for the engine's stand-in platform, one for each demo case, keyed by the case title, and one more for an endorsement case entered by hand with the title 'Venn, sum insured for the vehicle: endorsement'. Each follows the reply shape of its agent and the right answers of the invented insurer's scenario list. Each says that it comes from the stand-in and that nothing was saved.
